sentences.en: The result of globalization is the triumph of unique thought.
sentences.zh: 全球化的一个结果是独特思想的胜利。

sentences.en: Globalization brought us the possibility of fast and instantaneous communication.
sentences.zh: 全球化使我们有了快速即时交流的可能性。

sentences.en: I think that globalization has negative effects as well as positive.
sentences.zh: 我认为全球化既有积极影响也有消极影响。
